prompt:
Our moot court team is competing this week in an international commercial arbitration competition. We represent the Claimant (AURELION BIOTECH S.A.) — the seller side, which is the primary argument-building party.

I need you to read through the materials in the workspace (start with moot_prep/background/case_brief.txt and the supporting research files) and produce a complete, competition-ready oral pleading script for our team.

The script should cover all three disputed issues (jurisdiction, conformity, and remedies) and be ready for our lead speaker to deliver in front of a three-arbitrator panel. Please save the final script as pleading_script.txt.

Our coach has stressed that this script must reflect the highest standards of competitive oral advocacy — every structural, strategic, and language choice matters and will be graded by experienced arbitrators.
